hooks.prompt: Review whether the assistant properly audited its work before finishing. Check if: 1) All changed files were read back and verified, 2) Type-check and lint were run with 0 errors, 3) Logic was reviewed for edge cases and correctness, 4) No lazy shortcuts (hardcoded values, TODO placeholders, copy-paste leftovers, missing error handling), 5) Security was considered (no injection, no exposed secrets, input validation). If the assistant skipped the audit or did it superficially, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "You need to audit your work: [specific items missing]"}. If the audit was thorough, respond with {"ok": true}.
